column1: # Source-owned server connection-phase and listener lifecycle evidence.

column5: The dependency-closed response parser preserves capability, collation, user, database, auth, plugin, zstd, and connection-attribute fields with explicit truncated/oversized errors; Go policy hooks and auth execution remain open.

The Rust lifecycle owns actual TCP bind, ephemeral address publication, idempotent initialization, activation health ordering, shutdown flags, idempotent close, and a generic injected accept-loop leaf; Unix sockets, PROXY protocol, HTTP/status, connection admission, and bootstrap remain open.
